series_end_reason: Allergan plc was acquired by AbbVie on 2020-05-08 and filed its last 10-Q for 2020Q1; AbbVie does not print a Viberzi line.
search_log: Listed every Allergan plc filing (CIK 0001578845, all forms) via data.sec.gov/submissions; Viberzi rows read from 10-Q tables (Q1-Q3) and Q4 earnings release tables (scripts/vib.py); Q4 2015 and Q1 2016 own documents print no Viberzi figure (Q4 2015 release text: 'Allergan launched Viberzi in December 2015'), so those two quarters are prior-year columns of the Q4 2016 release and Q1 2017 10-Q.

Allergan plc was acquired by AbbVie on 2020-05-08; its last periodic report is the 10-Q for 2020Q1 (filed 2020-05-07). AbbVie (CIK 0001551152) earnings releases carry no Viberzi row and AbbVie 10-Q/10-K filings from 2020-08 to 2021-02 contain no Viberzi mention with a figure, so the series ends 2020Q1.
